gloss: atmospheric pressure; air pressure (in meteorology and physics)

definitions.explanation: The pressure exerted by the weight of the Earth's atmosphere on a surface. {大気圧|たいきあつ} is the standard term in meteorology, physics, and engineering. The everyday weather word {気圧|きあつ} is essentially the same thing in popular usage; {大気圧|たいきあつ} is more precise/scientific.

examples.japanese: {大気圧|たいきあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
⟦{標高|ひょうこう}→標高：13175_hyoukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{大気圧|たいきあつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Atmospheric pressure decreases as elevation rises.

examples.japanese: {大気圧|たいきあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Changes in atmospheric pressure are deeply related to the weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{標準|ひょうじゅん}→標準：04832_hyoujun⟧{大気圧|たいきあつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦およそ→およそ：02534_oyoso⟧{千|せん}{十三|じゅうさん}ヘクトパスカル⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧おり、{気象観測|きしょうかんそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Standard atmospheric pressure is taken to be about 1013 hPa and is used as the reference in weather observation.

notes:
{大気圧|たいきあつ} is the technical term for atmospheric pressure — the pressure exerted by the weight of the air column above a given point.

FORMS:
- ⟦{大気|たいき}→大気：03388_taiki⟧ ("atmosphere") + {圧|あつ} (from ⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧ "pressure") → {大気圧|たいきあつ}

KEY FACTS (typical contexts):
- The standard reference value is approximately 1013.25 hPa (ヘクトパスカル) at sea level.
- {大気圧|たいきあつ} decreases with altitude — a key concept in mountaineering, aviation, and meteorology.
- The term shows up in physics (⟦{気体|きたい}→気体：02632_kitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法則|ほうそく}→法則：05143_housoku⟧ "gas laws"), engineering (vacuum systems), cooking (high-altitude cooking), and weather forecasting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大気圧|たいきあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ / ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: atmospheric pressure falls / rises
- ⟦{標準|ひょうじゅん}→標準：04832_hyoujun⟧{大気圧|たいきあつ}: standard atmospheric pressure
- {大気圧|たいきあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧: changes in atmospheric pressure
- {大気圧|たいきあつ}{下|か}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: under atmospheric pressure (in scientific writing)

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{気圧|きあつ}→気圧：00219_kiatsu⟧: atmospheric pressure (everyday and meteorological term) — the word used in daily weather reports and forecasts. Largely interchangeable with {大気圧|たいきあつ} in casual contexts. {気圧}⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧ "pressure pattern," ⟦{高|こう}{気圧|きあつ}→高気圧：14808_koukiatsu⟧ "high-pressure system," ⟦{低|てい}{気圧|きあつ}→低気圧：21712_teikiatsu⟧ "low-pressure system" all use the shorter form.
- ⟦{高|こう}{気圧|きあつ}→高気圧：14808_koukiatsu⟧: high-pressure system
- ⟦{低|てい}{気圧|きあつ}→低気圧：21712_teikiatsu⟧: low-pressure system
- ⟦{気圧計|きあつけい}→気圧計：27376_kiatsukei⟧: barometer (instrument for measuring air pressure)
- ⟦{気圧|きあつ}{配置|はいち}→気圧配置：27750_kiatsuhaichi⟧: atmospheric pressure pattern (a forecasting term)
- ヘクトパスカル: hectopascal (hPa) — the standard unit used in Japanese weather reports

USAGE:
- In everyday weather conversation, native speakers usually say ⟦{気圧|きあつ}→気圧：00219_kiatsu⟧, not {大気圧|たいきあつ} (e.g., "⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気圧|きあつ}→気圧：00219_kiatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧" "the air pressure is low today, so my head hurts").
- {大気圧|たいきあつ} is preferred in textbooks, academic writing, and contexts where the contrast with vacuum or other reference pressures matters (e.g., "{大気圧|たいきあつ}{下|か}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧" "under atmospheric pressure" in chemistry experiments).
